# routeros_apps (Data Source)
Read App definitions and deployment status on RouterOS 7.25.1 with the container package. Reading does not start or update Apps. Returned definitions may contain secrets and are stored in Terraform state.

## Example Usage
```terraform
data "routeros_apps" "custom" {
  filter = {
    custom = "true"
  }
}

# data.routeros_apps.custom.data includes sensitive YAML and environment values.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Map of String) Additional request filtering options.

### Read-Only

- `data` (List of Object, Sensitive) Catalog and custom Apps, including sensitive composition and environment values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
